what_this_run_supports: This cycle adds no new capability. It independently re-verifies, without alteration, the already-accepted OUTCOME A result: under the frozen geometry rule (sha256 a7452748d40c511a14a1c7848ece5fe7f8f8901cc30f45a66918c89eb593a633) applied byte-identically to the three served bundles of gate_packet/38839347028 (de 214, fr 217, it 211), the relevance_ordered variant (V2) passes 22/33 criteria versus the incumbent's 16/33, with zero criterion regressions on any bundle (de 7/11, fr 8/11, it 7/11 versus incumbent 6/5/5).
The gains come from removing un-hydrated shells from the clusterable INPUT, not from the relevance axis: the frozen scorer computes PROJ_RANK without reading x/y, so no axis placement can move it.

The component is a pure, deterministic, drop-in function behind the query_result_bundle seam emitting the shipped qmap shape (cluster_id, x, y, label, size, member_ids) with no rendering, UI, colour or interaction change; source-linking fields are preserved on every row and no decision is dropped or duplicated.

The accepted ablation numbers reproduce independently: fr largest-cluster share 0.7696, dominant un-hydrated fraction 0.2934, hydrated-only dominant-member Jaccard 0.2348, frozen ARTIFACT predicate False on the shipped fr input, and 4 of 217 French-language rows inside the dominant cluster (2.4%). Under either variant the dominant cluster contains zero un-hydrated shells (fraction 0.0000 on all three bundles), so the predicate is False for a structural reason, correctly stated.
what_this_run_does_not_support: THAT THE PROMOTED AXIS IS A RERANK SCORE IN THE MEASUREMENT POPULATION. In served packet 38839347028, provenance.stages == ['search'], there is no provenance.product_rerank key, and 0 rows carry retrieval_score_raw; decisions[].score is therefore the RAW SEARCH-STAGE score (ranges 0.5-35917 de, 0.5-57.7 fr, 0.8-3132 it; Spearman(score, rank) = -0.11 / -0.30 / -0.49). On the product hot path the same field IS the rerank score, because pipeline.py calls rerank_product_bundle, which rewrites row['score'] to a 0..1 local-legal TF-IDF relevance score. The artifacts' metadata label ('rerank_score_axis_with_query_language_bands', 'x = min-max normalised rerank score') and README line 34 are therefore inaccurate for what was measured; the user-facing disclosure text ('horizontal position is the retrieval relevance score') and the contract's field list (decisions[].score) are correct. The charter supplied the 'rerank score' premise; the team adopted its wording without testing it.

THAT THE PROMOTED PER-CRITERION NUMBERS TRANSFER UNSTATED TO PRODUCTION. Because the identical drop-in on the hot path would place points on a different quantity (a 0..1 rerank score coherent with rank, not an anti-correlated raw search score), Core Product must re-run the frozen rule on a bundle that has actually been through rerank_product_bundle and compare against the 7/8/7 baseline before serving V2. This item is absent from the contract's what_product_must_re_measure_if_it_adopts list.
That the map is USEFUL to a jurist. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and is not answered here.

That proximity now means query-conditioned similarity: PROJ_SPEARMAN and PROJ_KNN10 still fail on every bundle under both variants; STRUCTURE_SEP fails on every bundle and is measurably unreachable on de and it under any clustering.
That any decision supports, limits or contradicts the answer.
That the shipped map should be served unchanged: 0 of 3 bundles pass all 11 criteria under the promoted variant, exactly as under the incumbent.
That OUTLIER_VALIDITY is reachable on it: the co-citation graph is empty there, so the frozen DEGENERATE->FAIL clause fires under any variant.
